03 / Physical vs Turne

Everything you love about events. Without the hall.

At a physical eventOn Turne
  • A booth in a big hallA live video pod for every brand and startup
  • Walking the floor for hoursHop between pods in one tap
  • Queuing for a demoWatch it live, or book a 1:1 call
  • Swapping business cardsFollow the brand and hear first what's next
  • One lucky draw at one boothGuaranteed giveaways at every event
  • Travel, tickets and one cityFree, from anywhere in India

Better than being there.

  • No travel, no ticketsJoin from your phone or laptop, wherever you are. Always free.
  • Hop pods instantlyLeave a room, walk into the next one. No crowds, no queues.
  • See what's liveViewer counts and live tags show you where the action is.
  • Win every time you show upEvery event comes with real giveaways you can enter.
